description: This script contains functions for checking and performing upgrades on SD cards, including partition validation, image flashing, and configuration copying.

methods.name: legacy_sdcard_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the partition layout of an SD card image has changed by comparing partition tables.

methods.name: legacy_sdcard_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the SD card upgrade process, including writing images and handling partitions based on user options.

methods.name: legacy_sdcard_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration files to the boot partition of the SD card.
